annotations.title: Resolve Positions to ACI Risk Indicators

description: Map up to 200 positions, each given by its identifiers, to the ACI Risk Indicators of the providers behind them. Accepted identifiers: a venue, composite or share-class FIGI; a ticker with its MIC; an LEI; a chain id with a contract address; an ACI provider slug; a DTI. ISINs and CUSIPs are not accepted, and a position carrying one is refused. Each position comes back, in input order, with an `outcome`: `resolved`, with the instrument, every role and entity linked to it, and the provider's `risk_band`, `score` and `snapshot_id`; `ambiguous`, with the candidates, which a `module_hint` narrows; `withheld`; `uncovered`; or `out_of_scope`. Every outcome but `resolved` carries a `reason_code`. Nothing is guessed: an identifier matches exactly or not at all. A position carries its identifiers only; market values are not accepted. Access: Professional plan and above. If the user is not signed in, calling this tool starts the sign-in to their Aethon Credit Intelligence account.

mapping_seq.description: A published mapping version to pin, by number. The latest by default. An unknown number is refused, never replaced.

identifiers.description: One or more identifiers of the position.

chain.description: For `chain_contract`: the CAIP-2 chain id, such as `eip155:1`.

mic.description: For `ticker_mic`: the ISO 10383 MIC of the venue, or its operating MIC.

type.description: `figi`, `ticker_mic`, `lei`, `chain_contract`, `provider_slug` or `dti`. Any other type, an ISIN or a CUSIP among them, is refused together with the position that carries it.

module_hint.description: Narrows this position to one module. Answers an `ambiguous` result with one of its candidates' modules.

provider_subtype.description: The module's `provider_subtype`, where the subtype is its own module (`cefi` or `defi` for stablecoins).

position_ref.description: The caller's own opaque reference, echoed in the result and never used to resolve: at most 64 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and . _ : -. Not a client name or an account number.
